speed_flat_m_s.note: Comfortable walking pace on flat ground; Apollo lunar EVA traverse speeds were of the same order. Matches the backend default.

eva_max_duration_min.note: Oxygen supply expressed as EVA duration: the current NASA EMU provides oxygen for up to 7 hours (NASA OIG IG-17-018, p. 8). A 30-minute secondary oxygen pack is kept as the emergency reserve. o2_used_pct = duration / this value.

max_slope_deg.note: Default walkable slope for a suited astronaut on loose regolith. User can change it in the interface (10-30 deg).
